topics.title: Be动词 (am/is/are)
topics.summary: am用于I，is用于第三人称单数，are用于复数和you
topics.detail: be动词是最基本的系动词，表示'是/存在'。I am (I'm) / You are (You're) / He is (He's) / She is / It is / We are / They are。否定：am not / isn't / aren't。疑问：Are you...? / Is he...? 缩写：I'm=I am，you're=you are，he's=he is。be动词后接名词、形容词、介词短语等作表语。

examples.en: I am a student.
She is happy.
They are my friends.
Is he a teacher?

topics.tips: 口诀：I用am，you用are，is连着他她它，单数is复数are。

topics.title: 人称代词 (主格与宾格)
topics.summary: 主格作主语(I/you/he/she/it/we/they)，宾格作宾语(me/you/him/her/it/us/them)
topics.detail: 人称代词分主格和宾格。主格(I/you/he/she/it/we/they)在句中作主语，位于动词前。宾格(me/you/him/her/it/us/them)作动词或介词的宾语，位于动词或介词后。第三人称单数：he→him，she→her，it→it。复数we→us，they→them。判断方法：作主语用主格，作宾语用宾格。

examples.en: He is my brother.
examples.cn: 他是我的兄弟。(主格作主语)

examples.en: I like her.
We help them.
Listen to me, please.
examples.cn: 请听我说。(介词后用宾格)

topics.tips: 口诀：主格当主语，宾格当宾语，动词介词后面跟宾格。

topics.title: 物主代词 (my/your 与 mine/yours)
topics.summary: 形容词性物主代词后接名词(my book)，名词性物主代词单独使用(mine)
topics.detail: 物主代词分两类。形容词性物主代词(my/your/his/her/its/our/their)必须后接名词，相当于形容词，如 my book。名词性物主代词(mine/yours/his/hers/its/ours/theirs)单独使用，相当于'形容词性物主代词+名词'，如 This is mine = This is my book。注意 his/its 两种形式相同。hers/yours/ours/theirs 都带 s。

examples.en: This is my pen.
examples.cn: 这是我的钢笔。(形容词性+名词)

examples.en: This pen is mine.
examples.cn: 这支钢笔是我的。(名词性)

examples.en: Her bag is red. Mine is blue.
examples.cn: 她的包是红色的。我的是蓝色的。

examples.en: Our school is bigger than theirs.
examples.cn: 我们的学校比他们的大。

topics.tips: 口诀：形容词性要带名(词)，名词性能当名(词)用；his/its 两不变，其余加 s 变名词性。

quiz.q: Is this ___ book? (这是你的书吗)
This is not my car. It is ___.
Our team won. ___ is the best!

topics.title: 指示代词 (this/that/these/those)
topics.summary: this/these指近处，that/those指远处；单数this/that，复数these/those
topics.detail: this(这个)和these(这些)指距离说话人近的事物；that(那个)和those(那些)指距离远的事物。this/that是单数，后接单数名词；these/those是复数，后接复数名词。打电话时this is...表示'我是...'，that is...表示'你是...'。介绍他人用 This is... 而不用 He/She is...。

examples.en: This is a book.
These are books.
That is her house.
Those are beautiful flowers.

topics.tips: 口诀：this/these 距离近，that/those 距离远；this单these复，记住配对别搞混。

quiz.q: Look at ___ stars in the sky. (远处)

topics.title: 名词复数 (规则变化)
topics.summary: 一般加-s；s/sh/ch/x/o结尾加-es；辅音+y变y为i加-es；f/fe变v加-es
topics.detail: 可数名词变复数的规则变化：①一般直接加 s (books/cats/dogs)。②以 s, sh, ch, x 结尾加 es (buses/watches/boxes/brushes)。③以辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 es (city→cities, story→stories)；元音字母+y 直接加 s (boys/days)。④以 f 或 fe 结尾，变 f 为 v 加 es (leaf→leaves, knife→knives, wolf→wolves)；少数只加 s (roof→roofs, chief→chiefs)。⑤以 o 结尾的有生命的加 es (tomato→tomatoes, potato→potatoes, hero→heroes)；无生命的或外来词加 s (photos/pianos/zoos/radios)。

examples.en: I have two cats.
There are three buses.
The cities are beautiful.
She has two knives.

topics.tips: 口诀：直接加 s 最常见，sh/ch/x/s/o 多加 es；y 前是辅音 y 变 i 加 es；f/fe 变 v 加 es。

quiz.q: There are five ___ on the tree.

topics.title: 名词复数 (不规则变化)
topics.summary: man→men, foot→feet, child→children等不规则变化；部分单复数同形
topics.detail: 可数名词的不规则复数变化需单独记忆：①变内部元音：man→men, woman→women, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, goose→geese, mouse→mice。②词尾加 ren/en：child→children, ox→oxen。③单复数同形：sheep, deer, fish, Chinese, Japanese, series, species。④外来词保留原复数：analysis→analyses, crisis→crises, phenomenon→phenomena, criterion→criteria, datum→data, medium→media, bacterium→bacteria。⑤有些词只有复数形式：trousers, scissors, glasses, clothes, goods。这些变化虽不规则但使用频率高，需要熟记。

examples.en: The children are playing.
She has white teeth.
I saw three sheep on the farm.
examples.cn: 我在农场看到三只羊。(单复同形)

examples.en: The data is correct.

topics.tips: 口诀：man-men、foot-feet、tooth-teeth、child-children 记心里；sheep/deer/fish 单复同，analysis→analyses 学外语。

quiz.q: The ___ are playing in the garden.
I saw three ___ on the farm.
He has two ___ on his foot.

topics.title: 冠词 (a/an/the)
topics.summary: a用于辅音音素前，an用于元音音素前，the表特指
topics.detail: 冠词分不定冠词(a/an)和定冠词(the)。a 用于辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前(a book/a university，u发/juː/是辅音)；an 用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前(an apple/an hour，h不发音)。the 表特指(说话双方都知道的、上文提过的、独一无二的事物 the sun)。三餐、球类、学科前通常不用冠词；乐器前用 the (play the piano)。注意判断用 a 还是 an 看的是发音(音素)，不是字母。

examples.en: I have a book.
She is an honest girl.
examples.cn: 她是个诚实的女孩。(h不发音用an)

examples.en: He is a university student.
The sun is bright.

topics.tips: 口诀：看音不看字母，辅音音素用 a，元音音素用 an；特指、独一无二用 the，乐器前面也用 the。

topics.title: There be 句型
topics.summary: There is + 单数/不可数，There are + 复数；就近原则
topics.detail: There be 句型表示'某处有某物'，be动词的单复数由紧跟其后的最近名词决定(就近原则)。There is + 单数可数名词/不可数名词；There are + 复数名词。否定在 be 后加 not (There isn't / aren't)。疑问把 be 提到 there 前：Is there...? / Are there...? 注意 there be 与 have 的区别：there be 表客观存在，have/has 表主观拥有。There be 不能与 have 连用。

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
There are some apples.
There is some water in the cup.
Is there a park near here?

topics.tips: 口诀：There be 表存在，is 还是 are 看最近；单数不可数用 is，复数名词才用 are。

quiz.q: There ___ a pen and two books.
There ___ two books and a pen.
There ___ some milk in the glass.

topics.title: 祈使句
topics.summary: 动词原形开头表命令/请求；否定用 Don't + 动词原形
topics.detail: 祈使句用来表示命令、请求、建议或禁止，以动词原形开头，主语 you 通常省略。肯定句直接动词原形 (Open the door.)。否定句在句首加 Don't (Don't open the door.)。let 引导：Let's go. (让我们走)。为表示礼貌可加 please (Please sit down. / Sit down, please.)。加强语气可在句首加 Do (Do be careful.)。never 开头也是否定祈使 (Never give up.)。

examples.en: Open the window, please.
Don't be late.
Let's go home.
Never give up.

topics.tips: 口诀：祈使句，动词原形开头走；否定 Don't 站排头；礼貌 please 来帮忙，let us 变 let's 一起走。

topics.title: 疑问词 (what/where/when/who/how)
topics.summary: 特殊疑问词引导特殊疑问句，不能用yes/no回答
topics.detail: 疑问词用来引导特殊疑问句，不能用 Yes/No 回答。what(什么)问事物；where(哪里)问地点；when(何时)问时间；who(谁)问人(主格)；whom(谁，宾格)；whose(谁的)问所属；why(为什么)问原因(用 because 回答)；which(哪个)问选择；how(怎样)问方式/程度。常用组合：how old(多大), how many(多少，接可数), how much(多少，接不可数/问价格), how long(多长/多久), how often(多经常), how far(多远)。结构：疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序。

examples.en: What is your name?
Where do you live?
When will you come?
How old are you?

topics.tips: 口诀：what 问事物，where 问地点，when 问时间，who 问是谁，why 问原因，how 问方式。

quiz.q: — ___ is the library? — It's near the bank.
— ___ are you late? — Because I missed the bus.

topics.title: 一般疑问句
topics.summary: 把be/情态动词/助动词提到句首，用Yes或No回答
topics.detail: 一般疑问句用 Yes 或 No 回答，把 be 动词(am/is/are/was/were)、情态动词(can/must/may/will)或助动词(do/does/did/have/has)提到主语前构成。①含be/情态动词：He is a teacher. → Is he a teacher? ②实义动词(一般现在时)：用 do/does；He likes apples. → Does he like apples? ③一般过去时用 did，动词还原原形。回答：Yes, I do. / No, I don't. 注意肯否回答保持一致(前肯后肯，前否后否)。

examples.en: Are you a student? — Yes, I am.
examples.cn: 你是学生吗？— 是的，我是。

examples.en: Can you swim? — No, I can't.
examples.cn: 你会游泳吗？— 不，我不会。

examples.en: Does he like apples? — Yes, he does.
examples.cn: 他喜欢苹果吗？— 是的，喜欢。

examples.en: Did you see him? — No, I didn't.
examples.cn: 你看见他了吗？— 没有。

topics.tips: 口诀：be/情态/助动词，提到句首变问句；肯否回答要一致，Yes/No 后面别忘词。

quiz.q: He likes milk. (变一般疑问句) ___ he ___ milk?
She is a doctor. (变一般疑问句) ___ she a doctor?

topics.title: 特殊疑问句
topics.summary: 疑问词+一般疑问句语序；不能用Yes/No回答
topics.detail: 特殊疑问句是以疑问词(what/where/when/who/why/how等)开头的疑问句，不能用 Yes/No 回答，需给出具体信息。结构：疑问词 + 一般疑问句的语序(即 be/情态/助动词 + 主语 + 谓语)。①含be动词：What is this? / Where are you going? ②含实义动词(现在时)：What do you do? / Where does he live? ③过去时用 did，动词还原：Where did you go yesterday? ④对主语提问时语序不变(直接用疑问词替换主语)：Who broke the window? 注意对主语提问用 who/what，对宾语提问用 whom/what，对定语提问用 whose/which。

examples.en: What are you doing?
Where does she work?
When did you arrive?
Who broke the window?
examples.cn: 谁打破了窗户？(对主语提问语序不变)

topics.tips: 口诀：疑问词开头加一般疑问句语序；对主语提问不倒装，对其他成分要变序。

quiz.q: — ___ do you go to school? — By bus.
— ___ did you go yesterday? — The park.

topics.title: 情态动词 (can/must/may)
topics.summary: 情态动词后接动词原形；can表能力，must表必须，may表许可/可能
topics.detail: 情态动词表示能力、许可、必须、可能等，后接动词原形，无人称和数的变化(第三人称单数也不加s)。can 表能力或请求(Can you help me?)；must 表必须、禁止(mustn't)；may 表许可或可能(May I come in? / It may rain)。否定：can't(不能)，mustn't(禁止)，needn't(不必)。must 的一般疑问句，否定回答用 needn't 或 don't have to(不必)，不用 mustn't。表推测：must be(一定是)，can't be(不可能是)。

examples.en: I can speak English.
You must finish it now.
May I come in?
— Must I go? — No, you needn't.

topics.tips: 口诀：情态动词加原形，人称单复都不变；can 能力 must 必须，may 许可又可能；must 问句答 needn't。

quiz.q: — Must I hand in now? — No, you ___.

topics.title: 比较级和最高级
topics.summary: 单音节加-er/-est，多音节加more/most；as...as同级比较
topics.detail: 形容词/副词的比较等级变化：①单音节和部分双音节词加 -er / -est (tall→taller→tallest)。②以e结尾加 -r / -st (large→larger→largest)。③辅音+y 变 i 加 -er/-est (happy→happier→happiest)。④重读闭音节双写尾字母加 -er/-est (big→bigger→biggest)。⑤多音节和部分双音节前加 more/most (beautiful→more beautiful→most beautiful)。⑥不规则：good/well→better→best；bad/ill→worse→worst；many/much→more→most；little→less→least；far→farther/further。比较级用 than 连接；同级比较 as + 原级 + as；not as/so...as 表'不如'。

examples.en: Tom is taller than me.
She is the best student.
He runs as fast as you.
This box is bigger than that one.

topics.tips: 口诀：短词加 er/est，长词 more/most 来帮忙；good-better-best，bad-worse-worst 要记牢；比较级用 than，同级 as...as 不能忘。

quiz.q: This is the ___ book I have ever read.

topics.title: 反义疑问句
topics.summary: 前肯后否，前否后肯；用be/情态/助动词与主句一致
topics.detail: 反义疑问句由'陈述句 + 简短疑问'构成，原则是'前肯后否，前否后肯'。疑问部分的主语必须与陈述部分一致(用相应代词)，动词用 be/情态动词/助动词，时态与主句一致。①He is a teacher, isn't he? ②You like tea, don't you? ③She can't swim, can she? 注意特殊情况：Let's...→shall we?；Let us...→will you?；祈使句→will you?；few/little/hardly/never 等否定词时主句视为否定，后用肯定；I am→aren't I?；think/believe 等主从复合句，疑问部分与主句一致。

examples.en: He is a student, isn't he?
You don't like fish, do you?
Let's go, shall we?
She can swim, can't she?

topics.tips: 口诀：前肯后否，前否后肯；动词跟着主句走，Let's 用 shall we，祈使句用 will you。

topics.title: 并列连词 (and/but/or/so)
topics.summary: and表并列，but表转折，or表选择，so表因果
topics.detail: 并列连词连接两个对等的词、短语或句子。①and(和、并)表并列：I like apples and bananas. / He came and sat down. ②but(但是)表转折：She is poor but happy. / I want to go but I can't. ③or(或者、否则)表选择：Tea or coffee? / Hurry up, or you'll be late. ④so(所以)表因果：It was late, so I went home. ⑤for(因为)表补充原因：He must be tired, for he worked all night. 注意：and/or 连接多个成分时通常只在最后两个之间用连词(A, B and C)。both...and(既...又)，either...or(要么...要么)，neither...nor(既不...也不)是成对连词。

examples.en: I like apples and bananas.
She is young but smart.
Hurry up, or you'll be late.
It was raining, so I stayed home.

topics.tips: 口诀：and 并列 but 转折，or 选择 so 表果；both...and 一起来，either...or 二选一。

quiz.q: It was late, ___ I went home.

topics.title: 数词 (基数词与序数词)
topics.summary: 基数词表数量(one/two/three)，序数词表顺序(first/second/third)
topics.detail: 数词分基数词和序数词。基数词(one→two→three→...→ten→hundred→thousand→million→billion)表数量。序数词(first→second→third→fourth→fifth→...→tenth→hundredth)表顺序，通常加 the。序数词变化规律：①一般加 th (four→fourth, six→sixth)。②特殊：one→first, two→second, three→third, five→fifth, eight→eighth, nine→ninth, twelve→twelfth。③以 ty 结尾变 y 为 i 加 eth (twenty→twentieth)。④以 ve 结尾变 ve 为 f 加 th (five→fifth, twelve→twelfth)。21st→twenty-first(基+序)。表达编号：Lesson Three = the third lesson。 hundred/thousand/million 前有具体数字时不加 s(three hundred)，表约数时加 s(thousands of)。

examples.en: I have three books.
He is the first to arrive.
There are hundreds of people.
May is the fifth month.

topics.tips: 口诀：基数 one-two-three，序数 first-second-third；一般加 th 记住，特殊 1/2/3/5/8/9/12 要牢记。

quiz.q: March is the ___ month of the year.
There are ___ students in the class.

topics.title: 时间表达法
topics.summary: at+时刻，on+日期/星期，in+月/年/季节；顺读法和逆读法
topics.detail: 时间介词用法：①at + 时刻(at 8 o'clock, at noon, at midnight)。②on + 日期/星期/具体某天(on Monday, on July 4th, on a cold day)。③in + 月/年/季节(in May, in 2020, in spring, in the morning)。表达时刻两种方法：①顺读法(直接读数字)：8:15→eight fifteen。②逆读法(先分后时)：8:15→a quarter past eight。past(过了，分钟≤30) / to(差，分钟>30)：8:30→half past eight；8:45→a quarter to nine。表频率：every day, twice a week, three times a month。

examples.en: I get up at 6:30.
We meet on Monday.
She was born in 2000.
It's a quarter past eight.

topics.tips: 口诀：at 时刻 on 日期，in 年月季节要牢记；past 过了 to 差到，分小于三十用 past。

topics.title: 一般现在时
topics.summary: 表经常性动作或客观事实；第三人称单数动词加-s/es
topics.detail: 一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作或客观真理、状态。常配 always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day 等时间状语。结构：主语 + 动词原形。第三人称单数(he/she/it/单个人名)动词加 s/es：①一般加 s (works)；②s/sh/ch/x/o 结尾加 es (goes/watches)；③辅音+y 变 i 加 es (studies)；④特殊 have→has。否定：don't/doesn't + 动词原形。疑问：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形？客观真理即使主句过去时，从句也用一般现在时。

examples.en: I go to school every day.
She works in a hospital.
The sun rises in the east.
He doesn't like coffee.

topics.tips: 口诀：经常习惯或真理，一般现在来表示；三单动词加 s/es，否定 doesn't 加原形。

topics.title: 一般过去时
topics.summary: 表过去发生的动作；动词加-ed，不规则需记；否定用didn't+原形
topics.detail: 一般过去时表示过去某个时间发生的事，常配 yesterday, last week, in 2010, ... ago 等。规则动词加 ed：①一般加 ed (worked)；②e 结尾加 d (liked)；③辅音+y 变 i 加 ed (studied)；④重读闭音节双写尾字母加 ed (stopped)。不规则动词需单独记忆(go→went, see→saw, have→had, do→did, buy→bought, take→took)。否定：didn't + 动词原形。疑问：Did + 主语 + 动词原形？be 动词过去式 was/were。

examples.en: I visited my grandma yesterday.
She went to Beijing last year.
Did you see the film?
He didn't come to school.

topics.tips: 口诀：过去动作用过去式，规则加 ed 不规则记；否定 didn't 加原形，疑问 Did 后动词也还原。

topics.title: 一般将来时 (will)
topics.summary: will + 动词原形；表预测、意愿、临时决定或承诺
topics.detail: will + 动词原形构成一般将来时，表示对将来的预测、意愿、临时决定、承诺或请求。常配 tomorrow, next week, soon, in the future, later 等。①表预测：It will be sunny tomorrow. ②表临时决定(说话时才决定的)：I will answer the phone. ③表意愿/承诺：I will help you. ④表请求：Will you pass me the salt? 否定：will not = won't。疑问：Will + 主语 + 动词原形？shall 用于第一人称(I/we)表建议或征求意见(Shall we go?)，现代英语中 will 更常用。there be 将来式：There will be。

examples.en: I will call you tomorrow.
It will be sunny.
I will help you with your homework.
Will you marry me?

topics.tips: 口诀：will 加原形表将来，预测意愿临时决定；否定 won't 疑问 Will 开头，shall 只问第一人称。

quiz.q: I ___ help you with your homework.
— The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.

topics.title: 一般将来时 (be going to)
topics.summary: be going to + 动词原形；表已计划的打算或根据迹象的预测
topics.detail: be going to + 动词原形表示已经计划好的打算或根据现有迹象做出的预测。结构：am/is/are going to + 动词原形，be 随主语变化。①表计划/打算(已决定的)：I am going to buy a new car. ②表根据迹象的预测(看到乌云判断要下雨)：Look at the clouds! It is going to rain. 否定：isn't/aren't going to。疑问：Is/Are + 主语 + going to + 动词原形？与 will 的区别：be going to 强调事先有计划，will 强调临时决定或泛泛预测。there be 的将来式：There is going to be。

examples.en: We are going to travel next week.
examples.cn: 我们下周要去旅行。(已计划)

examples.en: Look! It is going to rain.
They are going to visit their grandparents.
examples.cn: 他们打算去看望祖父母。

examples.en: She is going to be a doctor.

topics.tips: 口诀：be going to 表计划，事先打算有安排；看迹象来预测也用它，be 随主语变 am/is/are。

quiz.q: They ___ visit their grandparents next Sunday.
It ___ rain. Look at the dark clouds!
I ___ buy a new phone next month.

topics.title: 现在进行时
topics.summary: be + 动词-ing；表正在进行或现阶段
topics.detail: 现在进行时表示说话时正在进行的动作或现阶段正在做的事。结构：be(am/is/are) + 动词现在分词(动词 ing)。现在分词变化：①一般加 ing (doing)；②以不发音 e 结尾去 e 加 ing (making)；③以 ie 结尾变 y 加 ing (lying, dying)；④重读闭音节双写尾字母加 ing (running, swimming)。常配 now, right now, Look!, Listen!。部分动词一般不用进行时：know, like, want, believe, understand 等状态动词。go/come/leave 等可用进行时表将来(I'm leaving tomorrow.)。

examples.en: I am reading a book now.
She is singing.
Look! They are playing soccer.
He is coming tomorrow.
examples.cn: 他明天来。(进行时表将来)

topics.tips: 口诀：be 加 ing 正在做，am is are 随主变；不发音 e 去掉加 ing，重读闭音节双写字母。

topics.title: 过去进行时
topics.summary: was/were + doing；表过去某时刻正在进行的动作
topics.detail: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作。结构：was/were + 动词 ing。was 用于单数(I/he/she/it)，were 用于复数和 you。常配 at 8:00 yesterday, this time yesterday, when/while 从句。常与 when/while 连用：长动作(过去进行)被短动作(一般过去)打断——I was reading when he came in. while 引导的从句通常用进行时表同时进行的两个动作。

examples.en: I was watching TV at 8 last night.
She was cooking when he came.
They were playing in the garden.
While I was reading, he called.

topics.tips: 口诀：was were 加 ing，过去某时正进行；when 短动 while 长，长被打断记心上。

quiz.q: She ___ a shower when I arrived.

topics.title: 现在完成时
topics.summary: have/has + 过去分词；表过去发生对现在有影响，或持续到现在
topics.detail: 现在完成时表示过去发生并对现在有影响的动作，或从过去持续到现在的动作/状态。结构：have/has + 过去分词。常配 already(肯定), yet(否定/疑问), just(刚刚), ever, never, before, since+时间点, for+时间段。①表影响：I have lost my key.(钥匙现在还没找到) ②表经历：Have you ever been to Beijing? ③表持续(接延续性动词)：I have lived here for 3 years. 注意：瞬间动词(buy, die, join, borrow)不能与 for/since 连用，需换成 be+名词/形容词(have been dead for 3 years)。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has lived here for 5 years.
Have you ever been to Japan?
He has just left.

topics.tips: 口诀：have/has 加过分，过去影响到现在；already 肯定 yet 否问，since 点 for 段要分清。

quiz.q: — ___ you ever ___ to Beijing? — Yes, twice.

topics.title: 过去完成时
topics.summary: had + 过去分词；表过去的过去
topics.detail: 过去完成时表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作，即'过去的过去'。结构：had + 过去分词(各人称都用 had)。常配 by the time, before, when, after, by the end of last... 等过去时间参照。①By the time he arrived, the train had left.(火车先离开，他后到) ②When I got there, the meeting had started. ③said/told 后接宾语从句，若从句动作先于主句，从句用过去完成时。强调'比另一个过去动作更早'。

examples.en: He had left before I came.
The train had gone when we arrived.
She said she had finished it.
By 5 pm, I had done all the work.
examples.cn: 到下午5点我已经做完所有工作。

topics.tips: 口诀：had 加过分，过去的过去；先发生的用过去完成，后发生的用一般过去。

quiz.q: When I arrived, the meeting ___ already.
By the time we got there, the bus ___.

topics.title: 将来完成时
topics.summary: will have + 过去分词；表到将来某时之前已完成
topics.detail: 将来完成时表示在将来某一时间之前已经完成的动作，强调到将来某时刻为止的结果。结构：will have + 过去分词。常配 by + 将来时间点(by tomorrow, by next year, by the end of this month), before, when 引导的将来时从句。①By next year, I will have lived here for 10 years. ②I will have finished the work by 5 pm. ③When you arrive, the meeting will have ended. 常与 by 短语搭配，表示'到...为止已经...'。否定：will not have done。疑问：Will + 主语 + have done？

examples.en: I will have finished by 5 pm.
By next year, she will have graduated.
They will have built the bridge by 2025.
examples.cn: 到2025年他们将建成这座桥。

examples.en: When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
examples.cn: 你到时我将已做好晚饭。

topics.tips: 口诀：will have 加过分，将来某时已完成；常配 by 加时间点，'到...为止'记心间。

quiz.q: By next year, I ___ here for 10 years.
When you come, the meeting ___ ended.

topics.title: 现在完成进行时
topics.summary: have/has been + doing；表持续到现在的动作，强调'一直在做'
topics.detail: 现在完成进行时表示从过去某时开始一直持续到现在的动作，可能仍在继续，强调动作的持续性。结构：have/has been + 动词 ing。常配 for + 时间段, since + 时间点, all morning, how long。①I have been waiting for an hour.(强调等了一小时这个持续过程) ②How long have you been learning English? 与现在完成时区别：现在完成进行强调'一直在做'，现在完成强调'已完成或结果'。状态动词(know/like)不用此进行时。

examples.en: I have been studying for 3 hours.
She has been working all day.
How long have you been waiting?
It has been raining since morning.

topics.tips: 口诀：have been 加 doing，一直在做到现在；强调持续配 for/since，状态动词不用它。

quiz.q: I ___ for you for two hours.

topics.title: 过去完成进行时
topics.summary: had been + doing；表过去某时之前一直持续的动作
topics.detail: 过去完成进行时表示在过去某一时间之前一直持续进行的动作，强调动作的持续性。结构：had been + 动词 ing。常配 for + 时间段, since + 时间点, by then 等。①By the time he arrived, I had been waiting for 2 hours.(强调在'他到'之前'一直等了'2小时) ②She had been working all day before she got sick. ③He said he had been learning English for 5 years. 与过去完成时区别：过去完成进行强调'一直在做'(可能未完成)，过去完成强调'已完成的结果'。状态动词不用此进行时。

examples.en: I had been waiting for 2 hours when he arrived.
examples.cn: 他到时我已经等了2小时。

examples.en: She had been working all day before she rested.
examples.cn: 她休息前工作了一整天。

examples.en: He had been studying for 3 hours when I called.
examples.cn: 我打电话时他已经学了3小时。

examples.en: They had been living there since 2010.

topics.tips: 口诀：had been 加 doing，过去某时一直在做；强调持续配 for/since，过去完成强调已完成。

quiz.q: I ___ for 2 hours when he arrived.
She ___ all day before she rested.
He ___ there for 5 years when he moved.

topics.title: 被动语态 (一般时态)
topics.summary: be + 过去分词；一般现在/过去/将来时的被动形式
topics.detail: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者。一般时态被动结构：①一般现在时：am/is/are + done (English is spoken here.) ②一般过去时：was/were + done (The window was broken.) ③一般将来时：will be + done (The work will be done.) 否定在 be 后加 not(isn't done, wasn't done, won't be done)。疑问把 be/will 提前(Is it done? / Was it done? / Will it be done?)。主动变被动：宾语变主语，谓语变 be done(时态体现在 be 上)，主语变 by 短语。不及物动词没有被动语态。

examples.en: English is spoken here.
examples.cn: 这里说英语。(一般现在被动)

examples.en: The window was broken by him.
examples.cn: 窗户被他打破了。(一般过去被动)

examples.en: The work will be done tomorrow.
examples.cn: 工作明天完成。(一般将来被动)

examples.en: Rice is grown in the south.

topics.tips: 口诀：被动 be 加过分，执行者用 by 引；时态变化在 be 上，is/are/was/were/will be。

topics.title: 被动语态 (进行时)
topics.summary: be + being + 过去分词；表正在被做
topics.detail: 进行时态的被动语态结构为 be + being + 过去分词。①现在进行时的被动：am/is/are + being done。The house is being built.(房子正在被建) ②过去进行时的被动：was/were + being done。The house was being built when I left.(我走时房子正在被建) 否定：isn't being done / wasn't being done。疑问：Is it being done? / Was it being done? 注意：将来进行时和完成进行时一般不用被动语态。此结构强调动作'正在被进行'，突出承受者。

examples.en: The house is being built.
The car was being repaired.
The problem is being discussed.
The road was being fixed when we passed.
examples.cn: 我们经过时路正在被修。

topics.tips: 口诀：进行被动 be 加 being 加过分；is being/was being 正在被，时态变化在 be 上。

topics.title: 被动语态 (完成时)
topics.summary: have/has/had been + 过去分词；表已被做
topics.detail: 完成时态的被动语态结构为 have/has/had been + 过去分词。①现在完成时被动：have/has been done。The book has been read.(书已被读过) ②过去完成时被动：had been done。The work had been finished by 5 pm.(到5点工作已被完成) ③将来完成时被动：will have been done。The project will have been completed by next year. 否定：hasn't been done / hadn't been done。疑问：Has it been done? / Had it been done? 强调动作'已经被完成'的结果。

examples.en: The book has been read.
The work had been finished by 5 pm.
The room has been cleaned.
All tickets have been sold out.

topics.tips: 口诀：完成被动 have been 加过分；has been/had been 已被做，been 是标志记清楚。

topics.title: 被动语态 (带情态动词)
topics.summary: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词；can/must/may be done
topics.detail: 带情态动词的被动语态结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。①can/may/must + be done：The work must be done.(工作必须被做) / It can be finished today.(今天能被完成) ②含 have to/ought to：The homework has to be done.(作业必须被做) ③含 used to：This building used to be a school.(这建筑过去是学校) 否定：can't be done / mustn't be done / needn't be done。疑问：Can it be done? / Must it be done? 注意：情态动词后的被动一律用 be + done(原形)，不受时态影响。need doing = need to be done(需要被做)：The room needs cleaning = needs to be cleaned。

examples.en: The work must be done today.
It can be finished soon.
The room needs cleaning.
examples.cn: 房间需要打扫。(need doing=need to be done)

examples.en: This problem should be solved.

topics.tips: 口诀：情态被动 can be done，must/may/should 都加 be；need doing 等于 need to be done。

topics.title: used to do 句型
topics.summary: used to + 动词原形，表过去常常(现已不)
topics.detail: used to + 动词原形，表示过去经常做某事或过去存在的状态，而现在已不再如此。①肯定：He used to smoke. ②否定：didn't use to 或 usedn't to。③疑问：Did...use to? 或 Used...to? 注意区分：①used to do 过去常常(现已不)；②be used to doing 习惯于做(表状态，to 是介词)；③be used to do 被用来做(被动)。三者形式相近但含义不同，要结合上下文判断。

examples.en: I used to play basketball.
examples.cn: 我过去常打篮球。(现已不常打)

examples.en: He didn't use to drink coffee.
Did you use to live here?
She is used to getting up early.
examples.cn: 她习惯早起。(be used to doing)

topics.tips: 口诀：used to do 过去常常，be used to doing 习惯于；否定 didn't use to，疑问 Did...use to。

quiz.q: I ___ live in Shanghai, but now I live in Beijing.
He ___ like spicy food, but now he does.

topics.title: 宾语从句 (that引导)
topics.summary: that引导陈述句作宾语；that在口语中常省略；陈述语序
topics.detail: that 引导的宾语从句由 that 连接一个陈述句，that 在从句中不作任何成分，仅起连接作用。①I think (that) he is right.(that 口语中常省略) ②He said that he would come. ③I believe that she is honest. that 不可省略的情况：①介词后(that 不能省)：I'm sure of that he will come.(误)→I'm sure that he will come. ②并列多个宾语从句时，最后的 that 可省，前面的不省：He said (that) he was tired and that he wanted to rest. 两大要点：①语序用陈述语序(主语+谓语)；②时态呼应：主句现在时/将来时，从句按实际需要用时态；主句过去时，从句用相应过去时态。

examples.en: I think (that) he is right.
He said that he would come.
I believe that she is honest.
She told me that she was tired.

topics.tips: 口诀：that 引导陈述句，口语之中可省去；介词之后不能省，并列从句前不省。

quiz.q: I think ___ he is a good man.

topics.title: 宾语从句 (if/whether引导)
topics.summary: if/whether引导一般疑问句作宾语；whether较正式，可接or not
topics.detail: if 或 whether 引导的宾语从句由一般疑问句转换而来，表'是否'。①I don't know if he will come.(我不知道他是否会来) ②She asked whether I liked it.(她问我是否喜欢) if 与 whether 的区别：①whether 较正式，if 较口语。②whether 可接 or not (whether...or not)，if 一般不接 or not 在从句末。③whether 可放介词后(I'm not sure about whether...)，if 不能。④whether 可引导主语从句/表语从句，if 一般不能。⑤whether 可接不定式(whether to go)，if 不能。两大要点：陈述语序 + 时态呼应。

examples.en: I don't know if he will come.
She asked whether I liked it.
I wonder whether it is true or not.
examples.cn: 我想知道这是否是真的。

examples.en: He asked if I had eaten.

topics.tips: 口诀：if/whether 问是否，whether 正式可加 or not；介词后/不定式前用 whether，口语 if 更常用。

quiz.q: I don't know ___ he will come.
I'm not sure about ___ he will come.
I wonder ___ to go or not.

topics.title: 宾语从句 (疑问词引导)
topics.summary: what/who/when/where/why/how引导特殊疑问句作宾语；陈述语序
topics.detail: 疑问词(what/who/whom/whose/which/when/where/why/how)引导的宾语从句由特殊疑问句转换而来。①I don't know what he wants. ②Could you tell me where the bank is?(注意陈述语序，不是 where is the bank) ③She asked why he was late. ④I wonder how he did it. 两大要点：①语序：一律用陈述语序(主语+谓语)，即使原句是疑问句。②时态呼应：主句现在时/将来时，从句按需要用时态；主句过去时，从句用相应过去时态。③疑问词在从句中充当成分(主语/宾语/状语等)，不可省略。客观真理不受时态限制。

examples.en: I don't know what he wants.
Could you tell me where the bank is?
examples.cn: 请问银行在哪里？(陈述语序)

examples.en: She asked why he was late.
I wonder how he did it.
examples.cn: 我想知道他是怎么做到的。

topics.tips: 口诀：疑问词引导宾从句，陈述语序记心里；主过从过真理不变，疑问词充当成分不可省。

topics.title: 定语从句 (who/whom/whose)
topics.summary: who作主语/宾语(人)，whom作宾语(人)，whose作定语表所属
topics.detail: who/whom/whose 引导定语从句修饰表示人的先行词。①who 在从句中作主语或宾语(口语中作宾语也可用 whom)：The man who is talking is my teacher. ②whom 在从句中作宾语(动词或介词的宾语)，较正式：The man whom I met is a doctor. ③whose 在从句中作定语，表所属(可修饰人或物)：The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend. whose 修饰物时相当于 of which。作宾语时关系代词常省略：The man (whom/who) I met is a doctor. 注意：whom 在现代口语中常被 who 或省略替代，但在正式书面语中仍使用。

examples.en: The man who is talking is my teacher.
examples.cn: 正在说话的那个人是我老师。(who作主语)

examples.en: The man whom I met is a doctor.
examples.cn: 我遇到的那个人是医生。(whom作宾语)

examples.en: He is the boy whose father is a doctor.
examples.cn: 他就是那个爸爸是医生的男孩。(whose作定语)

examples.en: The girl whose hair is long is my sister.

topics.tips: 口诀：who 人作主/宾语，whom 只作宾语用；whose 表所属修饰定，人/物都能修饰它。

quiz.q: The man ___ is singing is my brother.
The man ___ I met yesterday is a doctor.
I know a boy ___ father is a pilot.

topics.title: 定语从句 (which/that)
topics.summary: which修饰物，that修饰人或物；作宾语可省略
topics.detail: which 和 that 引导定语从句修饰表示事物的先行词。①which 在从句中作主语或宾语(物)：This is the book which I like. ②that 可修饰人或物，作主语或宾语：This is the book that I bought. 作宾语时 which/that 可省略：This is the book (that/which) I bought. 只用 that 的情况：①先行词被最高级修饰(the best book that...)；②先行词被 the only/very/just 修饰；③先行词是不定代词(all/anything/nothing/everything)；④先行词既包括人也包括物。只用 which 的情况：非限制性定语从句(有逗号)中不能用 that，要用 which。

examples.en: This is the book that I bought.
This is the book which I like best.
He is the best student that I have ever seen.
examples.cn: 他是我见过的最好的学生。(只用that)

examples.en: I have nothing that I want to say.
examples.cn: 我没有什么想说的。(不定代词用that)

topics.tips: 口诀：which 修饰物 that 通用人/物；作宾语可省略，最高/only/不定代词只用 that。

quiz.q: This is the book ___ I like best.
He is the best student ___ I have ever seen.
I have nothing ___ I want to say.

topics.title: 定语从句 (关系副词 when/where/why)
topics.summary: when修饰时间，where修饰地点，why修饰原因；在从句中作状语
topics.detail: 关系副词 when/where/why 引导定语从句，在从句中作状语，分别修饰表时间、地点、原因的先行词。①when 修饰表时间的先行词(time/day/year)，相当于 at/on which。②where 修饰表地点的先行词(place/school/city)，相当于 in/at which。③why 修饰 reason，相当于 for which。判断用关系代词还是副词：看从句缺不缺主/宾——缺主宾用 that/which/who，不缺(只缺状语)用 when/where/why。如：This is the place where I live.(从句 I live 不缺主宾，缺地点状语→where)。非限制性定语从句中 when/where 也可使用。

examples.en: I remember the day when we met.
examples.cn: 我记得我们相遇的那天。

examples.en: This is the city where I was born.
That is the reason why he was late.
I'll never forget the year when I came here.
examples.cn: 我永远不会忘记来这的那年。

topics.tips: 口诀：when 时间 where 地点，why 修饰 reason；缺主宾用代词，只缺状语用副词。

quiz.q: I still remember the day ___ we first met.
This is the house ___ I lived.
Tell me the reason ___ you were late.

topics.title: 定语从句 (限制性与非限制性)
topics.summary: 限制性无逗号不可省，非限制性有逗号可省；非限制性不用that
topics.detail: 定语从句分限制性和非限制性。①限制性定语从句：无逗号隔开，不可省略(去掉后句意不完整)，用于限定先行词的范围。The man who is talking is my teacher.(限定是哪个man) ②非限制性定语从句：有逗号隔开，可省略(去掉后句意仍完整)，用于补充说明先行词。Beijing, which is the capital, is beautiful.(补充说明北京) 区别：①非限制性从句不能用 that，必须用 who/which。②非限制性从句可修饰整个句子。He passed the exam, which made me happy.(which 指代整个句子) ③非限制性从句的关系词不可省略。④专有名词通常用非限制性(因为已唯一确定)。

examples.en: The man who is talking is my teacher.
examples.cn: 正在说话的男子是我老师。(限制性)

examples.en: Beijing, which is the capital, is beautiful.
examples.cn: 北京，是首都，很美。(非限制性)

examples.en: My father, who is 60, loves sports.
examples.cn: 我父亲，60岁了，热爱运动。(非限制性)

examples.en: He passed, which made me happy.
examples.cn: 他通过了，这让我很高兴。(which指代全句)

topics.tips: 口诀：限制无逗不可省，非限制有逗可省；非限制不用 that，which/who 来引导。

quiz.q: Beijing, ___ is the capital, is beautiful.
The man ___ is talking is my teacher.
He passed the exam, ___ made me happy.

topics.title: 状语从句 (时间)
topics.summary: when/while/as/before/after/until/as soon as引导；主将从现
topics.detail: 时间状语从句由 when/while/as/before/after/until/since/as soon as/once 等引导。①when 当...时(可接时间点或时间段)：When I got home, it was raining. ②while 当...时(接延续性动作，常配进行时)：While I was reading, he called. ③as 一边...一边/随着：As we walked, we talked. ④before 在...前 / after 在...后。⑤until 直到...：I waited until he came. ⑥as soon as 一...就：I'll call you as soon as I arrive. ⑦since 自从(主句完成时，从句一般过去时)：I have lived here since I was born。重要规则：主将从现——主句将来时，时间/条件从句用一般现在时表将来。If/When it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

examples.en: When I got home, it was raining.
While I was reading, he called.
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
examples.cn: 我一到就给你打电话。(主将从现)

examples.en: I waited until he came.

topics.tips: 口诀：when 当...时 while 延续，as soon as 一...就；until 直到 before 前，主将从现要记牢。

quiz.q: When I ___ home, it was raining.
I'll call you as soon as I ___.

topics.title: 状语从句 (原因 because/since/as)
topics.summary: because表直接原因(回答why)；since/as表已知原因；because与so不连用
topics.detail: 原因状语从句由 because/since/as/for/now that 等引导。①because 因为(语气最强，表直接原因，可回答 why 提问)：He didn't go because he was sick. ②since 既然(表已知的、显然的原因)：Since you are here, let's start. ③as 因为(语气最弱，表显而易见的原因)：As it is late, we should go. ④now that 既然：Now that you have finished, you can rest. 重要规则：because 与 so 不能在同一个句子中同时使用(中文'因为...所以'对应英文只用其一)。because 从句可放在主句前或后；since/as 引导的从句通常放主句前。for 是并列连词，表补充原因，不放在句首。

examples.en: He didn't go because he was sick.
Since you are here, let's start.
examples.cn: 既然你来了，我们开始吧。

examples.en: As it is late, we should go home.
examples.cn: 因为晚了，我们该回家了。

examples.en: He must be tired, for he worked all night.
examples.cn: 他一定累了，因为工作了一整夜。

topics.tips: 口诀：because 强 since/as 弱，because 能答 why 问句；because 和 so 不连用，中文'因为所以'要分开。

quiz.q: He didn't go to school ___ he was sick.
He was tired, ___ he went to bed early.

topics.title: 状语从句 (条件 if/unless)
topics.summary: if如果；unless除非(=if not)；as long as只要；主将从现
topics.detail: 条件状语从句由 if/unless/as long as/in case/provided that 等引导。①if 如果(表条件)：If it rains, I will stay home. ②unless 除非(=if not)：You won't pass unless you study harder. ③as long as 只要：As long as you try, you can succeed. ④in case 万一：Take an umbrella in case it rains. ⑤provided that 假如：Provided that you study, you will pass. 重要规则：主将从现——主句用将来时(will)，条件从句用一般现在时表将来。If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.(不用 will rain) unless = if not，故主句和从句的肯定否定要转换：Don't come unless you are invited = Don't come if you are not invited。

examples.en: If it rains, I will stay home.
examples.cn: 如果下雨我就待在家。(主将从现)

examples.en: You won't pass unless you study harder.
examples.cn: 除非你更努力学习，否则不会通过。

examples.en: As long as you try, you can succeed.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.

topics.tips: 口诀：if 如果 unless 除非，as long as 只要来；主将从现要牢记，unless 等于 if not。

quiz.q: If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay at home.
You won't pass ___ you study harder.

topics.title: 状语从句 (让步 although/though)
topics.summary: although/though/even though虽然；though与but不连用
topics.detail: 让步状语从句由 although/though/even though/even if/while 等引导，表'虽然/尽管'。①although 虽然(较正式，可放句首或句中)：Although it was raining, he went out. ②though 虽然(较口语，可放句末作副词)：He is poor, though. ③even though 即使(比 though 语气更强)：Even though it was hard, he didn't give up. ④even if 即使(表假设)：Even if it rains, I will go. ⑤while 虽然(表对比)：While I like it, I can't afford it. 重要规则：although/though 与 but 不能在同一句中同时使用(中文'虽然...但是'对应英文只用其一)。though 可作副词放句末(although 不行)。

examples.en: Although it was raining, he went out.
examples.cn: 虽然下雨，他还是出去了。

examples.en: Even though it was hard, he didn't give up.
Even if it rains, I will go.
He is smart, though he is young.

topics.tips: 口诀：although/though 表虽然，even though 更加强；though 和 but 不连用，though 可放句末作副词。

quiz.q: ___ it was raining, he went out.
Even ___ it was hard, he didn't give up.
Although he is tired, ___ he keeps working. (改错)

topics.title: 状语从句 (目的 so that)
topics.summary: so that/in order that 为了，以便；从句常含can/could/may/might
topics.detail: 目的状语从句由 so that/in order that 引导，表'为了/以便'，从句中通常含 can/could/may/might/will/would 等情态动词。①so that 以便(较常用)：I got up early so that I could catch the bus. ②in order that 为了(较正式)：He spoke loudly in order that everyone could hear. ③so as to / in order to + 动词原形(简化形式，不是从句)：I got up early so as to catch the bus. 区别：so that 引导从句(有主语+谓语)，so as to 引导短语(只有动词)。否定形式：so that...not = lest(以免)，in order that...not。目的状语从句可放主句前或后。

examples.en: I got up early so that I could catch the bus.
examples.cn: 我早起以便能赶上公交车。

examples.en: He spoke loudly in order that everyone could hear.
examples.cn: 他大声说话以便大家都能听到。

examples.en: She studies hard so that she can pass the exam.
examples.cn: 她努力学习为了能通过考试。

examples.en: I left early so that I wouldn't be late.

topics.tips: 口诀：so that 以便能，in order that 更正式；从句常含 can/could，so as to 是短语不是句。

quiz.q: I got up early ___ I could catch the bus.
He spoke loudly ___ everyone could hear.
She studies hard ___ she can pass.

topics.title: 状语从句 (结果 so...that)
topics.summary: so+形/副+that如此...以至于；such+a/an+名+that
topics.detail: 结果状语从句由 so...that / such...that 引导，表'如此...以至于'。①so + 形容词/副词 + that：He is so tall that he can reach the shelf. ②such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that：It is such a good book that I read it twice. ③so + many/much/few/little + 名词 + that：There are so many people that we can't get in. so 与 such 的区别：so 修饰形容词/副词，such 修饰名词。特殊结构：so + 形容词 + a/an + 名词(such a/an + 形容词 + 名词 的倒装变体)：so good a book = such a good book。so that 也可单独表'因此/所以'(无逗号时表目的，有逗号时表结果)。

examples.en: He is so tired that he fell asleep.
examples.cn: 他太累了以至于睡着了。

examples.en: It is such a good book that I read it twice.
examples.cn: 这本书太好以至于我读了两遍。

examples.en: She spoke so fast that I couldn't understand.
There were so many people that we left.
examples.cn: 人太多了我们只好走了。

topics.tips: 口诀：so 加形/副 such 加名，that 后面接结果；so many/much 接名词，such a/an 形名记清楚。

quiz.q: He is ___ tired that he fell asleep.
It is ___ a good book that I read it twice.
There were ___ many people that we left.

topics.title: 状语从句 (方式 as)
topics.summary: as/just as/as if/as though引导；表'像...一样/仿佛'
topics.detail: 方式状语从句由 as/(just) as/as if/as though 引导，表动作的方式或比较。①as 像...一样/按照：Do as I tell you. ②just as 正如：Just as I expected, he came. ③as if / as though 仿佛(后可接虚拟语气表非真实，或接陈述语气表可能)：He talks as if he knew everything.(虚拟，其实他并非什么都懂) / It looks as if it is going to rain.(可能要下雨，陈述) as if 与 as though 用法相同，可互换。the way 也可引导方式状语从句(口语)：Do it the way I showed you.

examples.en: Do as I tell you.
Just as I expected, he came.
He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.cn: 他说话好像什么都懂。(虚拟)

examples.en: It looks as if it will rain.

topics.tips: 口诀：as 像那样 just as 正如；as if/as though 仿佛，虚拟非真实用过去时。

topics.title: 主语从句
topics.summary: 作主语的从句；That+从句作主语(谓语单数)；常用It作形式主语
topics.detail: 主语从句在复合句中作主语。引导词：that(无意义，不省)/whether/wh-词。①That he is honest is true.(that 引导，谓语用单数) ②What he said is true.(what 在从句中作成分) 为避免头重脚轻，常用 It 作形式主语，把真正主语放后面：It is important that we learn English. / It is a pity that he failed. / It is unknown whether he will come. 注意：whether 引导主语从句可放句首，if 不能放句首作主语从句。主语从句作主语时，主句谓语一般用单数。

examples.en: That he is right is true.
It is important that we keep learning.
What he said is a secret.
It is unknown whether he will come.

topics.tips: 口诀：主从 that 不省略，谓语通常用单数；头重脚轻 It 帮忙，形式主语把位置占。

quiz.q: ___ he will come is still a question.
It is necessary ___ we learn English well.

topics.title: 表语从句
topics.summary: 系动词后作表语；The truth is that... / The question is whether...
topics.detail: 表语从句在系动词(be/look/seem/remain/become)后作表语，说明主语的内容或状态。引导词：that(常不省)/whether(是否，不用if)/as if/as though(仿佛)/because(因为)/wh-词。①The truth is that he lied. ②The question is whether we can finish. ③It looks as if it will rain. ④That is why he was angry. 注意：表语从句中 whether 可用，if 一般不用；reason 作主语时，表语从句用 that 不用 because(The reason is that...)。表语从句用陈述语序。

examples.en: The truth is that he is wrong.
The question is whether we can go.
It looks as if it will rain.
That is why he was angry.

topics.tips: 口诀：系动词后是表从，that/whether/wh- 都行；reason 作主用 that，as if 表语表'仿佛'。

quiz.q: The truth is ___ he didn't come.
The question is ___ we can finish it.
The reason is ___ he was ill.

topics.title: 同位语从句
topics.summary: 解释名词内容；fact/idea/news/hope + that(不省，不作成分)
topics.detail: 同位语从句用于解释或说明前面抽象名词的具体内容。常见先行词：fact(事实)/idea(想法)/news(消息)/hope(希望)/truth(真相)/question(问题)/belief(信念)/possibility(可能)等。引导词多用 that(that 不省略，且在从句中不作任何成分，只起连接作用，这与定语从句的 that 不同)。①The news that he won the prize is true. ②I have no idea when he will come. ③The fact that the earth is round is known to all. 区别定语从句：同位语从句的 that 不作成分，定语从句的 that 作主/宾；同位语从句解释名词'内容'，定语从句限定名词'范围'。

examples.en: The news that he won is true.
I have no idea when he will come.
examples.cn: 我不知道他什么时候来。

examples.en: The fact that the earth is round is true.
examples.cn: 地球是圆的这一事实是真的。

examples.en: The hope that he will recover is small.
examples.cn: 他会康复的希望很渺茫。

topics.tips: 口诀：同位解释名词意，fact/idea/news 后跟 that；that 不作成分不省略，定语从句要分清。

quiz.q: The news ___ he passed the exam made us happy.
I have no idea ___ he will come.
The fact ___ he is honest is known to all.

topics.title: 不定式作主语
topics.summary: To do 作主语(谓语用单数)；常用 It 作形式主语
topics.detail: 不定式(to do)可作句子的主语，谓语动词用单数。①直接作主语(放句首)：To learn English is important. ②用 It 作形式主语(更常用，避免头重脚轻)：It is important to learn English. 常见结构：It is + 形容词/名词 + to do(It is necessary to study hard. / It is a pleasure to meet you.) ③It takes sb + 时间 + to do(花某人多少时间做)：It took me 2 hours to finish. ④It is + 形容词 + for sb to do(对某人来说做...如何)：It is hard for me to learn Chinese. ⑤It is + 形容词 + of sb to do(评价人品)：It is kind of you to help me. 不定式的逻辑主语用 for 引出。

examples.en: To learn English is important.
examples.cn: 学英语很重要。(直接作主语)

examples.en: It is important to learn English.
examples.cn: 学英语很重要。(It作形式主语)

examples.en: It took me 2 hours to finish the work.
It is kind of you to help me.
examples.cn: 你能帮我真好。(评价人品用of)

topics.tips: 口诀：to do 作主语谓语单数，头重脚轻 It 来帮忙；for sb 加 to do 表对象，of sb to do 评人品。

quiz.q: It took me 2 hours ___ the work.
It is kind ___ you to help me.

topics.title: 不定式作宾语
topics.summary: want/decide/hope/plan + to do；疑问词+to do作宾语
topics.detail: 不定式(to do)可作动词或介词的宾语。①后接 to do 作宾语的动词：want/wish/hope/expect/plan/decide/offer/agree/promise/refuse/manage/pretend/afford/fail 等。I want to learn English. ②疑问词 + to do 作宾语：I don't know what to do. / She asked how to get there. ③find/think/make + it + 形容词 + to do(用 it 作形式宾语)：I find it hard to learn Chinese. ④后接 to do 的固定搭配：would like to, used to, be about to, have to, ought to, be to(表计划)。注意：enjoy/finish/mind/avoid 等后接 doing(动名词)，不接 to do。

examples.en: I want to learn English.
I don't know what to do.
I find it hard to learn Chinese.
examples.cn: 我觉得学中文很难。(形式宾语)

examples.en: She decided to go abroad.

topics.tips: 口诀：want/decide/hope/plan 接 to do，疑问词加 to do 也作宾；find it 加形再 to do，形式宾语 it 来替。

topics.title: 不定式作定语
topics.summary: to do 放名词后作定语；表将做/需做；something to eat
topics.detail: 不定式(to do)作定语时放在被修饰的名词/代词之后。①表将要做的事：I have a lot of work to do. / The meeting to be held tomorrow is important. ②表用途：a book to read(用来读的书), a room to live in(住的房间), something to eat(吃的东西), a pen to write with(用来写的笔) ③被修饰名词是不定式的逻辑宾语时，若不定式是不及物动词需加介词：a room to live in(不能说 a room to live), a chair to sit on, a pen to write with。④序数词/最高级/the only/next/last 后常接 to do：He is the first to come. / She is the best person to do the job.

examples.en: I have something to tell you.
I need a pen to write with.
examples.cn: 我需要一支笔来写字。(不及物加介词)

examples.en: He is the first to come.
I have a lot of work to do.

topics.tips: 口诀：to do 定语放名后，表将做或表用途；不及物动词加介词，live in / sit on / write with。

quiz.q: I need a room ___ live in.

topics.title: 不定式作状语
topics.summary: to do 作状语表目的/结果/原因；in order to / so as to
topics.detail: 不定式(to do)作状语可表目的、结果、原因等。①表目的(最常见)：I came to help you.(我来帮助你) 可用 in order to / so as to 强调目的：I got up early in order to catch the bus. ②表结果：He lived to be 90.(活到90岁) / I woke up to find him gone.(醒来发现他走了) only to 表出乎意料的结果：He hurried to the station, only to find the train gone. ③表原因(修饰表情绪的形容词)：I'm glad to see you. / He is sorry to hear that. ④too...to(太...以至于不能)：He is too tired to walk. ⑤enough to(足以)：He is old enough to go to school. 否定：not to / in order not to。

examples.en: He came to help me.
I'm glad to see you.
examples.cn: 见到你很高兴。(原因状语)

examples.en: He is too tired to walk.
He hurried there, only to find it closed.
examples.cn: 他赶到那里，却发现关门了。(出乎意料的结果)

topics.tips: 口诀：to do 作状语表目的，in order to 强调它；too...to 太...不能，only to 表意外结果。

topics.title: 动名词 (doing)
topics.summary: 动词+ing；可作主语/宾语/表语/定语；enjoy/finish/mind + doing
topics.detail: 动名词(动词 ing 形式)兼有动词和名词特征，可作主语、宾语、表语、定语。①作主语：Swimming is good for health.(谓语用单数) ②作宾语：enjoy/finish/practice/mind/avoid/consider/keep/give up + doing；介词后 + doing(be good at swimming, look forward to seeing)。③作表语：My hobby is reading. ④作定语：a swimming pool(游泳池), a reading room(阅览室)，表用途。注意区分现在分词作定语：a sleeping baby = 正在睡觉的婴儿(分词表动作进行)；动名词作定语表用途。常见考点：to 为介词的短语后接 doing：be used to, look forward to, pay attention to, object to。

examples.en: Swimming is fun.
I enjoy reading.
He is good at drawing.
This is a reading room.
examples.cn: 这是阅览室。(定语表用途)

topics.tips: 口诀：动名词 doing 兼名动，主宾表定都能用；enjoy/finish/mind 加 doing，介词后面也 doing。

topics.title: 分词 (现在分词与过去分词)
topics.summary: 现在分词doing表主动/进行；过去分词done表被动/完成
topics.detail: 分词是非谓语动词，分现在分词(doing)和过去分词(done)。现在分词表主动、进行；过去分词表被动、完成。及物动词：exciting news(令人兴奋的消息，主动)，excited people(感到兴奋的人，被动)。不及物动词：falling leaves(正落下的叶子，进行)，fallen leaves(已落下的叶子，完成)。分词可作：①定语：a broken cup(破杯子)；②状语：Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful.(被动)③宾补：have sth done(让某事被做)，see sb doing(看到正做)。重点区分：-ed 形容词修饰人(I'm interested)，-ing 形容词修饰物(The book is interesting)，但修饰表情时也可修饰人(a smiling boy)。

examples.en: The news is exciting.
I am excited.
He had his hair cut.
Seen from the hill, the city is beautiful.
examples.cn: 从山上看，城市很美。(过去分词表被动)

topics.tips: 口诀：现在分词主动进行，过去分词被动完成；-ing 修饰令人物，-ed 描写人的感受。

topics.title: 分词作定语
topics.summary: doing作定语表主动进行；done作定语表被动完成；放名词前后
topics.detail: 分词作定语修饰名词。①单个分词作定语通常放在名词前：a sleeping baby(正在睡觉的婴儿，现在分词表主动进行)；a broken cup(破碎的杯子，过去分词表被动完成)。②分词短语作定语放在名词后(相当于定语从句)：The man standing there is my teacher.(=who is standing there) / The book written by him is popular.(=which was written by him) ③现在分词表主动/进行：a crying child(哭泣的孩子), developing countries(发展中国家)。④过去分词表被动/完成：a developed country(发达国家), fallen leaves(落叶)。⑤区别动名词定语：a sleeping bag(睡袋，动名词表用途) vs a sleeping baby(睡觉的婴儿，分词表进行)。

examples.en: The man standing there is my teacher.
examples.cn: 站在那里的男子是我老师。(分词短语后置)

examples.en: A broken cup is on the table.
examples.cn: 桌上有个破杯子。(过去分词)

examples.en: The book written by him is popular.
examples.cn: 他写的书很受欢迎。(=which was written)

examples.en: Developing countries need help.
examples.cn: 发展中国家需要帮助。(现在分词)

topics.tips: 口诀：分词定语单前短后；doing 主动进行，done 被动完成；sleeping bag 表用途是动名词。

quiz.q: The man ___ there is my teacher.
The book ___ by him is popular.
A ___ cup is on the table.

topics.title: 分词作状语
topics.summary: doing/done作状语表时间/原因/条件/让步/伴随；逻辑主语与主句一致
topics.detail: 分词作状语修饰主句谓语动词或整个句子。现在分词(doing)表主动进行，过去分词(done)表被动完成。①表时间：Seeing the teacher, the students stood up.(=When they saw...) / Seen from the hill, the city is beautiful.(=When it is seen...) ②表原因：Being ill, he stayed home.(=Because he was ill) ③表条件：Given more time, I could do better.(=If I were given...) ④表让步：Though tired, he kept working.(=Though he was tired) ⑤表伴随/方式：He sat there, reading a book.(=and was reading) 重要规则：分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。如果不一致，需用独立主格结构。否定形式：Not knowing what to do, I asked for help.

examples.en: Seeing the teacher, the students stood up.
examples.cn: 看到老师，学生们站了起来。(时间)

examples.en: Seen from the hill, the city is beautiful.
examples.cn: 从山上看，城市很美。(被动)

examples.en: Being ill, he stayed home.
examples.cn: 因为生病，他待在家。(原因)

examples.en: He sat there, reading a book.

topics.tips: 口诀：分词状语逻辑主语同主句；doing 主动 done 被动，时间原因条件伴随都能用。

quiz.q: ___ the teacher, the students stood up.
___ from the hill, the city is beautiful.

topics.title: 独立主格结构
topics.summary: 名词/代词 + 分词/形/副/不定式，与主句主语不同，作状语
topics.detail: 独立主格结构由'名词或代词(主格) + 非谓语动词/形容词/副词/介词短语/名词'构成，自带逻辑主语(与主句主语不同)，在句中作状语(时间、原因、条件、伴随等)，相当于一个从句。①名词+现在分词(主动进行)：Weather permitting, we'll go out.(=If weather permits) ②名词+过去分词(被动完成)：The work done, we went home.(=When the work was done) ③名词+形容词：He stood there, his eyes bright. ④名词+副词：The meeting over, everyone left. ⑤with 复合结构(with + 宾语 + 宾补)也属此类：He slept with the window open. 独立主格没有谓语动词，与主句用逗号隔开。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we will go out.
examples.cn: 天气允许的话，我们就出去。

examples.en: The work done, we went home.
examples.cn: 工作做完后，我们回家了。

examples.en: He slept with the window open.
The meeting over, we all left.
examples.cn: 会议结束后，我们都离开了。

topics.tips: 口诀：独立主格自带主，名/代+分词/形/副；与主句主语不一样，作状语用逗号隔。

topics.title: 虚拟语气 (if 条件句)
topics.summary: 与现在相反(if+过去时,主句would do)；与过去相反(if+had done,主句would have done)
topics.detail: 虚拟语气表示假设、与事实相反或不大可能的情况。if 条件句的三种情况：①与现在事实相反：if + 一般过去时(be 用 were)，主句 would/should/could/might + 动词原形。If I were you, I would go. ②与过去事实相反：if + had + 过去分词，主句 would/should/could/might + have + 过去分词。If you had worked harder, you would have passed. ③与将来事实相反：if + 一般过去时 / were to do / should do，主句 would + 动词原形。If it should rain tomorrow, I would stay. 省略倒装：if 中含 had/were/should 可省略 if，把它们提到主语前(Had you come earlier...)。

examples.en: If I were you, I would go.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我就去。(与现在相反)

examples.en: If he had come, he would have seen her.
examples.cn: 如果他来了，就能见到她。(与过去相反)

examples.en: If it should rain, I would stay.
examples.cn: 万一明天下雨，我就留下。(与将来相反)

examples.en: Had you told me, I would have helped.
examples.cn: 要是你告诉我，我会帮忙。(省略倒装)

topics.tips: 口诀：现在反 if 加过去(were)，would 加原形；过去反 if had done，would have done；省 if 把 had/were 提前。

quiz.q: If I ___ you, I would not do that.
If he ___ harder, he would have passed.
If it ___ rain tomorrow, I would stay home.

topics.title: wish 与 as if 的虚拟
topics.summary: wish + did(现在)/had done(过去)/would do(将来)；as if + 虚拟
topics.detail: wish 后宾语从句用虚拟语气，表示'希望'(多与事实相反，难实现)。①与现在相反：wish + 一般过去时(be 用 were)。I wish I were young. ②与过去相反：wish + had + 过去分词。I wish I had studied harder. ③与将来相反：wish + would/could + 动词原形。I wish you would come. as if/as though(仿佛)后从句也用虚拟：与现在相反用过去时，与过去相反用 had done。He talks as if he knew everything. It is (high) time that + did/should do(早该做...)，也属虚拟：It's time we went home. 区分 hope 与 wish：hope 表可实现，后接陈述语气；wish 表难实现，用虚拟。

examples.en: I wish I were a bird.
examples.cn: 我希望我是一只鸟。(与现在相反)

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
examples.cn: 我真希望当初更努力。(与过去相反)

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.
examples.cn: 我希望雨能停。(与将来相反)

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.

topics.tips: 口诀：wish 现在过去将来，did/had done/would do；as if 也虚拟，It's time that 加 did。

quiz.q: I wish I ___ harder last year.
He talks as if he ___ everything.

topics.title: 虚拟语气 (would rather)
topics.summary: would rather + 动词原形(自己)；would rather + 从句(过去时/had done)
topics.detail: would rather 表'宁愿'，有两种用法。①would rather + 动词原形(主语自己宁愿做)：I would rather stay home. / I would rather not go. ②would rather + 从句(宁愿别人做)，从句用虚拟语气：与现在/将来相反用一般过去时(be 用 were)，与过去相反用 had done。I would rather you didn't smoke.(宁愿你不抽烟) / I would rather you had told me earlier.(宁愿你早告诉我) would rather...than...(宁愿...也不)：I would rather die than give up. would rather 后从句的主语与主句主语不同时才用虚拟；相同时用动词原形。

examples.en: I would rather stay home.
examples.cn: 我宁愿待在家。(自己宁愿)

examples.en: I would rather you didn't smoke.
examples.cn: 我宁愿你不抽烟。(虚拟，现在)

examples.en: I would rather you had told me earlier.
examples.cn: 我宁愿你早点告诉我。(虚拟，过去)

examples.en: I would rather die than give up.

topics.tips: 口诀：would rather 自己加原形，别人做用虚拟语气；现在/将来用过去时，过去反用 had done。

quiz.q: I would rather you ___ me earlier.

topics.title: 虚拟语气 (建议性动词)
topics.summary: suggest/demand/insist + (should) do；It is important that + (should) do
topics.detail: 虚拟语气在建议、命令、要求类动词后的用法。①表示建议、命令、要求、坚持的动词(suggest/advise/demand/require/insist/order/propose/request/urge)后宾语从句用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可省。He suggested that we (should) leave early. ②同位语/表语从句：suggestion/advice/order/demand/requirement + that + (should) do。My advice is that you (should) rest. / The order that everyone (should) come is clear. ③It is + 形容词/名词 + that 从句：important/necessary/essential/strange/natural/a pity + that + (should) do。It is important that we (should) learn. ④lest/for fear that(以免) + (should) do。注意：suggest 表'暗示/表明'时不用虚拟(从句用陈述语气)；insist 表'坚持说'时不用虚拟。

examples.en: He suggested that we leave early.
It is important that we learn.
The order is that everyone come.
He spoke loudly lest others (should) hear.
examples.cn: 他大声说话以免别人听到。

topics.tips: 口诀：建议命令和要求，insist/demand/suggest 都用(should) do；important/strange 后也虚拟，should 可省略。

quiz.q: It is necessary that he ___ there.
The order is that everyone ___ on time.

topics.title: 强调结构 (It is...that...)
topics.summary: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余；可强调主/宾/状
topics.detail: 强调结构用于强调句中某一成分(主语、宾语、状语)，结构为：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。强调人时可用 who，强调其他用 that。①强调主语：It is I that/who am right.(原句 I am right) ②强调宾语：It was the book that I bought.(原句 I bought the book) ③强调状语：It was in 2010 that he came.(强调时间状语) 判断方法：去掉 It is/was 和 that/who，剩下的部分若能组成完整句子，即为强调结构。注意：强调结构不强调谓语(强调谓语用 do/does/did：I do like it.)。强调时间/地点状语时用 that 不用 when/where。

examples.en: It is I who am right.
It was the book that I bought.
examples.cn: 我买的是这本书。(强调宾语)

examples.en: It was in 2010 that he came.
examples.cn: 是在2010年他来的。(强调时间状语)

examples.en: I do hope you can come.
examples.cn: 我真希望你能来。(do 强调谓语)

topics.tips: 口诀：强调结构 It is...that，主宾状语都能强；去 It 去 that 句仍通，强调谓语用 do/does/did。

quiz.q: It was Tom ___ broke the window.
It was in the room ___ I found it.
It is English ___ we are learning.

topics.title: 完全倒装
topics.summary: 表方位/时间的副词(here/there/up/down)+动词+主语(名词)
topics.detail: 完全倒装把整个谓语提到主语之前。常见结构：表方向、位置的副词(here/there/up/down/in/out/away/back/now/then)位于句首，且主语是名词时，用'副词 + 动词 + 主语'完全倒装。①Here comes the bus. ②Out rushed the children. ③On the table lies a book. 注意：①主语是代词时不倒装：Here he comes.(代词 he 不倒装) ②主语是名词才倒装。③表地点的介词短语位于句首强调地点时也可引起完全倒装：Under the tree sat an old man. 这种倒装使描写更生动形象。

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
Out rushed the boy.
Under the tree sat an old man.
Here he comes.

topics.tips: 口诀：方位副词在句首，名词主语才倒装；代词主语不倒装，Here comes the bus 记牢。

topics.title: 部分倒装
topics.summary: 否定词(hardly/never/not only/seldom)+助/情态/be+主语
topics.detail: 部分倒装只把助动词/情态动词/be 动词提到主语前，类似一般疑问句结构。常见情况：①否定副词或含否定意义的词位于句首：never, seldom, hardly, scarcely, rarely, little, not, not only, by no means, in no case 等。Never have I seen such a film. ②only + 状语(副词/介词短语/从句)位于句首：Only then did I understand. Only in this way can we succeed. ③not only...but also... 前倒后不倒：Not only does he sing, but he also dances. ④Hardly...when... / No sooner...than...：Hardly had I arrived when it rained. ⑤so/neither/nor 开头表'也/也不'：He likes it. So do I.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a film.
examples.cn: 我从没看过这样的电影。

examples.en: Only then did I understand.
Hardly had I arrived when it rained.
Not only does he sing, but he also dances.

topics.tips: 口诀：否定词在句首，部分倒装助/情/be；only 加状语在句首，Hardly...when 也要倒。

topics.title: 省略
topics.summary: 在不引起歧义时省略成分；状语从句中'主语+be'可省略
topics.detail: 省略是为了简洁，在不引起歧义的情况下省去句中某些成分。常见省略：①状语从句中的省略：当从句主语与主句主语一致，且从句谓语含 be 动词时，可同时省略'主语+be'。When (he was) asked, he kept silent. While (she was) reading, she fell asleep. Though (it is) small, the room is cozy. ②不定式的省略：to 后动词常省略，只保留 to——I asked him to come, but he didn't want to (come). ③并列结构省略相同成分：She likes apples, and I (like) pears. ④祈使句、答语、感叹中的省略：(You) Open the door. — Are you ready? — (I'm) Ready. 省略使语言更简洁地道。

examples.en: When asked, he kept silent.
examples.cn: 被问到时，他保持沉默。(省略he was)

examples.en: While reading, she fell asleep.
examples.cn: 读书时她睡着了。(省略she was)

examples.en: Though tired, he kept working.
examples.cn: 虽然累，他仍坚持工作。(省略he was)

examples.en: He wanted to come but couldn't (come).

topics.tips: 口诀：状从主语同主句，主语加 be 可省略；to 后动词可省去，并列相同也省略。

topics.title: 主谓一致 (就近原则)
topics.summary: there be/or/either...or/neither...nor中，谓语与最近主语一致
topics.detail: 主谓一致的就近原则：当主语由 or, either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also 连接时，谓语动词的单复数由离它最近的那个主语决定。①There is a pen and two books on the desk.(最近的a pen是单数，用is) ②There are two books and a pen on the desk.(最近的two books是复数，用are) ③Either he or I am wrong.(最近的I用am) ④Neither you nor he is right.(最近的he用is) ⑤Not only the students but also the teacher likes it.(最近的teacher单数用likes) ⑥There be 句型也遵循就近原则。注意与'意义一致'和'语法一致'区分。

examples.en: There is a pen and two books.
examples.cn: 有一支笔和两本书。(就近用is)

examples.en: There are two books and a pen.
examples.cn: 有两本书和一支笔。(就近用are)

examples.en: Either he or I am wrong.
examples.cn: 要么他要么我错了。(就近用am)

examples.en: Neither you nor he is right.

topics.tips: 口诀：or/either...or/neither...nor，谓语跟着最近走；There be 也就近，最近的名词定单复。

quiz.q: There ___ a book and two pens on the desk.

topics.title: 主谓一致 (意义一致)
topics.summary: 主语形式与意义不一致时按意义定谓语；集体名词/数字/度量衡
topics.detail: 主谓一致的意义一致原则：谓语动词的单复数根据主语表达的意义而非形式决定。①集体名词(family/team/class/audience/public)作为整体看用单数，强调个体成员用复数：My family is large. / My family are watching TV. ②表时间/距离/金钱/重量的复数名词作为整体用单数：Ten years is a long time. / Two hundred dollars is enough. ③不定代词(anyone/someone/everyone/nobody)用单数：Everyone is here. ④people/police/cattle 作复数用：The police are coming. ⑤news/mathematics/physics 形复意单用单数：The news is good. ⑥and 连接表同一概念用单数：Bread and butter is my breakfast. ⑦a number of + 复数用复数；the number of + 复数用单数。

examples.en: Ten years is a long time.
examples.cn: 十年是很长的时间。(度量用单数)

examples.en: My family are watching TV.
examples.cn: 我家人在看电视。(强调成员用复数)

examples.en: The police are coming.
The number of students is 50.
examples.cn: 学生数量是50。(the number用单数)

topics.tips: 口诀：集体名词整体单、成员复；时间金钱距离整体用单数；a number of 复数，the number of 单数。

topics.title: 反义疑问句特殊用法
topics.summary: I am→aren't I；think/believe后从句疑问跟主句；祈使句→will you
topics.detail: 反义疑问句的特殊情况：①I am → aren't I? (不用 amn't I)：I am right, aren't I? ②think/believe/suppose/imagine 等动词后的宾语从句，疑问部分跟主句的主语和动词(否定转移时按从句意义)：I don't think he is right, is he? / I think he is right, isn't he? ③few/little/hardly/never/seldom/rarely/nothing/nobody 等含否定意义的词，主句视为否定，疑问用肯定：He never comes late, does he? / Few people know it, do they? ④everything/anything/something → it：Everything is OK, isn't it? ⑤everyone/someone/nobody → they：Nobody knows, do they? ⑥祈使句 → will you? / won't you?：Open the door, will you? ⑦Let's → shall we?；Let us → will you?

examples.en: I am right, aren't I?
I don't think he is right, is he?
examples.cn: 我认为他不对，是吗？(否定转移)

examples.en: He never comes late, does he?
Open the door, will you?

topics.tips: 口诀：I am 后用 aren't I；think 否定转移跟从句；否定词主句视否定，祈使用 will you。

quiz.q: I don't think he is right, ___?

topics.title: 直接引语转间接引语
topics.summary: 人称、时态、时间地点状语需变化；疑问句用if/whether或疑问词
topics.detail: 直接引语转间接引语需变化：①人称变化：I/he→he, you→I/we(视语境)。②时态变化(主句过去时)：一般现在→一般过去，一般过去→过去完成，现在进行→过去进行，现在完成→过去完成，will→would, can→could, may→might, must→had to。客观真理时态不变。③时间状语：now→then, today→that day, yesterday→the day before, tomorrow→the next day, ago→before。④地点状语：here→there。⑤指示代词：this→that, these→those。⑥陈述句用 that 引导；一般疑问句用 if/whether 引导；特殊疑问句用疑问词引导；祈使句用 tell/ask sb to do。⑦语序用陈述语序。

examples.en: He said, 'I am tired.' → He said that he was tired.
examples.cn: 他说'我累了' → 他说他累了。

examples.en: She said, 'I will come.' → She said she would come.
examples.cn: 她说'我会来' → 她说她会来。

examples.en: He asked, 'Are you ready?' → He asked if I was ready.
examples.cn: 他问'你准备好了吗' → 他问我是否准备好了。

examples.en: She said, 'I saw it yesterday.' → She said she had seen it the day before.
examples.cn: 她说'我昨天看到的' → 她说前一天看到的。

topics.tips: 口诀：人称时态要变化，主过从过真理不变；now→then today→that day，here→there this→that。

quiz.q: He said, 'I am happy.' → He said that he ___ happy.
She said, 'I will come.' → She said she ___ come.
He asked, 'Do you know?' → He asked ___ I knew.

topics.title: 间接疑问句
topics.summary: 疑问句作宾语/主语时用陈述语序；Do you know what he is doing?
topics.detail: 间接疑问句是把疑问句嵌入主句中作宾语/主语，关键是用陈述语序(主语+谓语)，不要倒装。①Do you know + 疑问词引导的宾语从句：Do you know where he lives?(不用 where does he live) ②Could you tell me + 疑问词从句：Could you tell me when the meeting starts? ③I wonder + if/whether：I wonder if she will come. ④疑问词在从句中作主语时不需倒装(本身就在谓语前)：Do you know who broke the window? ⑤时态呼应：主句过去时，从句用相应过去时态。⑥疑问词后不用助动词 do/does/did：Do you know where he went?(不用 where did he go)。间接疑问句与直接疑问句的最大区别是语序——间接用陈述语序。

examples.en: Do you know where he lives?
examples.cn: 你知道他住哪吗？(陈述语序)

examples.en: Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
I wonder if she will come.
Do you know who broke the window?
examples.cn: 你知道谁打破窗户了吗？(主语提问不倒装)

topics.tips: 口诀：间接疑问陈述序，主语在前谓语后；疑问词后不加 do/does/did，直接主语加谓语。

topics.title: 非限定动词辨析
topics.summary: 不定式/动名词/分词作主宾定状补的区别与功能辨析
topics.detail: 非限定动词包括不定式(to do)、动名词(doing)和分词(doing/done)，它们不能独立作谓语。①不定式常表目的、将来、具体动作：I came to study English. ②动名词作主语/宾语具有名词性质：Swimming is fun. ③现在分词表主动进行：The boy reading a book is my brother. ④过去分词表被动完成：The book written by him sells well. ⑤作主语时动名词表一般习惯，不定式表具体一次：Walking is good for health. / To walk with you is a pleasure. ⑥作宾语时有些动词只接不定式(decide, hope, refuse)，有些只接动名词(enjoy, finish, avoid)，有些两者皆可但意义不同(stop, remember, forget)。⑦作定语时不定式表将来，动名词表用途，分词表状态。

examples.en: I decided to learn French.
examples.cn: 我决定学法语。(不定式作宾语)

examples.en: Reading novels is my hobby.
examples.cn: 读小说是我的爱好。(动名词作主语)

examples.en: The man standing there is my teacher.
examples.cn: 站在那里的人是我老师。(现在分词作定语)

examples.en: The broken glass is dangerous.
examples.cn: 破碎的玻璃很危险。(过去分词作定语)

topics.tips: 口诀：不定表将来与目的，动名词作主宾像名词；现在分词主动进行，过去分词被动完成。

quiz.q: The book ___ by him is popular.

topics.title: 动名词 vs 不定式
topics.summary: stop/remember/forget/try等词后接动名词与不定式意义不同
topics.detail: 某些动词后接动名词(doing)和不定式(to do)意义截然不同：①stop doing 停止正在做的事 / stop to do 停下来去做另一件事。②remember doing 记得做过(已做) / remember to do 记得要做(未做)。③forget doing 忘记做过 / forget to do 忘记要做。④try doing 尝试做看看效果 / try to do 努力设法做。⑤mean doing 意味着 / mean to do 打算做。⑥regret doing 后悔做过 / regret to do 遗憾地要做(常接tell/inform)。⑦go on doing 继续做同一事 / go on to do 接着做另一事。⑧like doing 喜欢做(习惯) / like to do 想要做(具体)。⑨be afraid of doing 害怕发生(无意) / be afraid to do 不敢做(有意)。

examples.en: Stop talking, please.
examples.cn: 请停止说话。(停止正在做的)

examples.en: He stopped to drink water.
examples.cn: 他停下来喝水。(停下来去做)

examples.en: I remember locking the door.
Remember to lock the door.

topics.tips: 口诀：doing表已做进行中，to do表未做将要做；stop remember和forget，doing to do要分清。

quiz.q: I remember ___ the door before I left.
Try ___ the door, maybe it's open.

topics.title: 分词独立结构
topics.summary: 名词/代词+分词构成独立主格，作状语补充说明
topics.detail: 分词独立结构(独立主格)由'逻辑主语(名词/代词)+分词'构成，与主句主语不同，作状语表时间、原因、条件、伴随等。①Weather permitting, we'll go out.(如果天气允许) ②The meeting over, everyone went home.(会议结束) ③He lying on the grass, I read a book.(他躺在草地上，我在看书) ④There being no bus, we had to walk.(没有公交车) ⑤It being Sunday, the store is closed.(因为是周日) ⑥独立结构中的being常可省略：The meeting (being) over, we left. ⑦with结构也属独立主格：With him helping me, I finished soon. ⑧独立结构没有谓语动词，只是一个短语。⑨分词用doing(主动进行)还是done(被动完成)取决于与逻辑主语的关系。

examples.en: Weather permitting, we'll go hiking.
examples.cn: 天气允许的话，我们去远足。

examples.en: The meeting over, everyone went home.
examples.cn: 会议结束，大家都回家了。

examples.en: There being no bus, we walked home.
examples.cn: 没有公交车，我们走路回家。

examples.en: It being Sunday, the shop is closed.

topics.tips: 口诀：名词加分词，独立主格句；主语各不同，状语来补充；being可省略，doing主动done被动。

topics.title: with 复合结构
topics.summary: with+宾语+宾补(分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词)，作状语或定语
topics.detail: with复合结构由'with+宾语+宾语补足语'构成，宾补可以是分词、形容词、副词、不定式或介词短语。①with+名词+现在分词(主动进行)：With him helping me, I finished soon. ②with+名词+过去分词(被动完成)：With the work done, he went home. ③with+名词+形容词(状态)：He slept with the window open. ④with+名词+副词(位置状态)：He came in with his hat on. ⑤with+名词+不定式(将来)：With so much work to do, I can't go. ⑥with+名词+介词短语：The girl with long hair is my sister. ⑦with结构作伴随状语最常见，也可作原因、条件状语。⑧with结构中的宾语与宾补有逻辑主谓关系。⑨with可省略变为独立主格：He lay (with) his eyes open.

examples.en: He slept with the window open.
examples.cn: 他开着窗睡觉。(形容词作宾补)

examples.en: With the work done, he relaxed.
examples.cn: 工作完成了，他放松了。(过去分词作宾补)

examples.en: With him helping, I finished soon.
examples.cn: 有他帮忙，我很快就完成了。(现在分词作宾补)

examples.en: She came in with a smile on her face.
examples.cn: 她面带微笑走进来。(介词短语作宾补)

topics.tips: 口诀：with加宾语加宾补，分词形副不介足；主动用doing被动done，伴随状语最常见。

quiz.q: With the work ___, he went home.
With so much homework ___, I can't play.

topics.title: as 引导让步 (倒装)
topics.summary: as引导让步状语从句需部分倒装：形容词/副词/名词/动词+as+主语+谓语
topics.detail: as引导让步状语从句时表'虽然/尽管'，必须把表语、副词、动词或名词提到as前面(部分倒装)。①形容词+as+主语+be：Tired as he was, he kept working.(虽然累) ②副词+as+主语+动词：Fast as he ran, he lost the race.(虽然跑得快) ③名词+as+主语+be(名词前不加冠词)：Child as he is, he knows a lot.(虽然是孩子) ④动词+as+主语+助动词：Try as he might, he failed.(虽然尽力) ⑤as可换though，意义相同：Cold though it was, we went out. ⑥注意：though引导让步也可倒装，但although不能倒装。⑦as引导让步从句比though/although更正式、更具文学性。⑧倒装的目的是强调被提前的部分。⑨这种结构常用于正式书面语。

examples.en: Tired as he was, he kept working.
examples.cn: 虽然很累，他仍继续工作。

examples.en: Child as he is, he knows a lot.
examples.cn: 虽是孩子，他知道得很多。(child前不加a)

examples.en: Fast as he ran, he lost.
examples.cn: 虽然跑得快，他还是输了。

examples.en: Try as he might, he failed.
examples.cn: 尽管他尽力了，还是失败了。

topics.tips: 口诀：as让步要倒装，形副名动放前方；名词提前不加冠，though可换although不可。

quiz.q: ___ as he is, he can lift 100kg.
___ as she was, she didn't give up.
___ as he might, he couldn't solve it.

topics.title: though 引导让步倒装
topics.summary: though引导让步可倒装，结构同as：形/副/名/动+though+主语+谓语
topics.detail: though引导让步状语从句时，可以正常语序(Though he is young)，也可部分倒装，把表语/副词/名词/动词提到though前。①形容词+though+主语+be：Young though he is, he is wise. ②副词+though+主语+动词：Hard though he tried, he failed. ③名词+though+主语+be(名词前通常不加冠词)：Hero though he is, he remains humble. ④动词+though+主语+助动词：Search though they might, they found nothing. ⑤though倒装与as倒装用法完全相同，可互换。⑥although不能用于倒装结构。⑦though倒装更具文学性和强调意味。⑧倒装部分是被强调的内容。⑨这种结构常见于正式文体和文学作品。

examples.en: Young though he is, he is wise.
Hard though he tried, he failed.
examples.cn: 虽然努力了，他还是失败了。

examples.en: Hero though he is, he stays humble.
Search though they might, they found nothing.
examples.cn: 尽管他们搜寻，什么也没找到。

topics.tips: 口诀：though让步可倒装，形副名动提前放；用法同as可互换，although不能这样用。

quiz.q: ___ though he is, he runs fast.
Which can be used in inversion?

topics.title: no matter 引导让步
topics.summary: no matter+疑问词=疑问词+ever，表'无论…都'
topics.detail: no matter引导让步状语从句，结构为'no matter+疑问词(what/who/when/where/how)+主语+谓语'，表'无论…都'。①No matter what happens, I'll support you.(无论发生什么) ②No matter who you are, you must obey the rules.(无论你是谁) ③No matter when you come, you're welcome.(无论何时来) ④No matter where you go, I'll follow.(无论去哪) ⑤No matter how hard it is, don't give up.(无论多难) ⑥no matter+疑问词可换成疑问词+ever：whatever=No matter what, whoever=No matter who。⑦however后接形容词/副词：However tired you are, keep going. ⑧whatever后接名词：Whatever weather it is, we'll go. ⑨no matter更正式，ever形式更口语化。⑩从句常用一般现在时表将来。

examples.en: No matter what happens, I'll stay.
examples.cn: 无论发生什么，我都会留下。

examples.en: No matter how hard it is, try again.
Whoever you are, please wait outside.
examples.cn: 无论你是谁，请在外面等。

examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow.

topics.tips: 口诀：no matter加疑问词，无论什么谁何时；how后接形容词副词，ever形式可替换。

quiz.q: ___ what you say, I won't change my mind.
No matter ___ hard it is, don't give up.

topics.title: 倍数表达法
topics.summary: 三种倍数句式：倍数+as...as / 倍数+比较级+than / 倍数+the size of
topics.detail: 英语表达倍数有三种常用结构：①倍数+as+形容词/副词原级+as：This room is twice as big as that one.(这个房间是那个的两倍大) ②倍数+比较级+than：This room is twice bigger than that one. ③倍数+the+名词(size/length/amount等)+of：This room is twice the size of that one. ④倍数词：twice两倍, three times三倍, four times四倍。⑤half表示一半：half as big as / half the size of。⑥三结构可互换，意义相同。⑦注意as...as之间用原级，比较级+than用比较级。⑧the size of后接名词或代词。⑨倍数词必须放在as/比较级/the前面。⑩常用于长度、面积、体积、数量等比较。

examples.en: This box is three times as heavy as that one.
examples.cn: 这个箱子是那个的三倍重。

examples.en: The new bridge is twice longer than the old one.
This room is twice the size of mine.
examples.cn: 这个房间是我的两倍大。

examples.en: He runs half as fast as you.
examples.cn: 他跑的速度是你的一半。

topics.tips: 口诀：倍数as原级as，倍数比较级than，倍数the size of；twice两倍times几，half一半要记牢。

quiz.q: This book is ___ as thick as that one.
This room is twice the ___ of that one.

topics.title: it 用法 (形式主语/宾语)
topics.summary: it作形式主语/形式宾语，代替不定式/动名词/从句
topics.detail: it可作形式主语或形式宾语，代替真正的主语/宾语(不定式、动名词、从句)，避免头重脚轻。①形式主语+不定式：It is important to learn English.(学英语很重要) ②形式主语+动名词：It's no use crying over spilt milk.(覆水难收) ③形式主语+从句：It is a pity that you missed the party.(真遗憾你错过了) ④常见句型：It takes sb time to do(花时间做) / It is said that(据说) / It seems that(似乎)。⑤形式宾语：I find it hard to learn French.(it代替to learn) ⑥I think it necessary that we should help him.(it代替that从句) ⑦形式宾语只用在make/find/think/feel等动词后。⑧it还用于强调句：It is/was+被强调部分+that/who+其他。⑨形式主语和强调句的区别：去掉It is...that后句子仍完整的是强调句。

examples.en: It is important to learn English.
examples.cn: 学英语很重要。(形式主语+不定式)

examples.en: It's no use crying now.
examples.cn: 现在哭也没用。(形式主语+动名词)

examples.en: It is a pity that you missed it.
examples.cn: 真遗憾你错过了。(形式主语+从句)

examples.en: I find it hard to quit smoking.
examples.cn: 我觉得戒烟很难。(形式宾语)

topics.tips: 口诀：it形式主语宾语替，不定动名从句后移；避免句子头重脚轻，find think make后作宾。

quiz.q: I find ___ hard to understand him.
___ is no use ___ over spilt milk.

topics.title: so do I / neither do I
topics.summary: so+助/情/be+主语表'也如此'，neither/nor表'也不'
topics.detail: 倒装结构'so+助动词/情态动词/be动词+主语'表'某人也如此'，'neither/nor+助/情/be+主语'表'某人也不'。①肯定倒装：He likes coffee. So do I.(我也喜欢) ②否定倒装：He doesn't like tea. Neither do I.(我也不) ③助动词与上文一致：He can swim. So can she.(用can) ④be动词与上文一致：He is a doctor. So am I.(用am) ⑤时态与上文一致：He went home. So did I.(用did) ⑥so表'确实如此'(主语相同时不倒装)：'It's hot.' 'So it is.'(确实热) ⑦neither和nor可互换。⑧如果前句有不同动词，需用do/does/did。⑨主语不同才倒装，主语相同不倒装。⑩这结构用于简洁回应，避免重复整个句子。

examples.en: He likes coffee. So do I.
She can't swim. Neither can I.
They are students. So are we.
'It's a nice day.' 'So it is.'
examples.cn: '今天天气好。' '确实如此。'(同主语不倒装)

topics.tips: 口诀：so肯定neither否，助情be动词跟着前；主语不同要倒装，主语相同不倒装。

topics.title: 强调句型 (It is...that)
topics.summary: It is/was+被强调部分+that/who+其他；可强调主宾状
topics.detail: 强调句结构'It is/was+被强调部分+that/who+句子其余部分'用于强调句中某一部分。①强调主语：It is I that/who am wrong.(是我错了) ②强调宾语：It was the book that I bought.(我买的是那本书) ③强调状语：It was yesterday that he came.(他是昨天来的) ④强调时间/地点状语用that，不用when/where：It was in 1990 that he was born.(用that) ⑤强调人可用who：It was Tom who broke the window. ⑥强调主语时that后动词与被强调主语一致：It is I who am wrong.(am与I一致) ⑦判断方法：去掉It is/was...that后句子仍完整即为强调句。⑧not until强调：It was not until midnight that he returned. ⑨一般疑问句强调：Was it you that broke it? ⑩强调句与形式主语区别看去掉后句子是否完整。

examples.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
examples.cn: 是汤姆打破了窗户。(强调主语)

examples.en: It was the book that I bought.
examples.cn: 我买的是那本书。(强调宾语)

examples.en: It was yesterday that he came.
examples.cn: 他是昨天来的。(强调状语)

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he returned.
examples.cn: 直到午夜他才回来。(not until强调)

topics.tips: 口诀：it is加被强调，that who来连接；去掉it is和that，句子完整是强调。

topics.title: 部分倒装
topics.summary: 否定词提前/only提前/so/neither等引起部分倒装
topics.detail: 部分倒装指把助动词/情态动词/be动词提到主语前。①否定副词提前：Never have I seen such a beautiful place. ②Not only放句首：Not only does he sing, but he also dances. ③Hardly...when：Hardly had I arrived when it rained. ④No sooner...than：No sooner had he left than it rained. ⑤Only+状语提前：Only then did I understand. ⑥so/neither提前：So beautiful is she that everyone likes her. ⑦频度副词often/many a time提前：Often have I warned you. ⑧Not until提前：Not until midnight did he return. ⑨虚拟语气倒装：Had I known, I would have helped. ⑩方位副词here/there提前且主语是名词时全倒装：Here comes the bus. ⑪如果主语是代词则不倒装：Here he comes.

examples.en: Never have I seen such beauty.
Only then did I understand.
Not only does he sing, but he also dances.
Here comes the bus.

topics.tips: 口诀：否定词提前要倒装，only加状语也倒装；助情be动词放主前，so neither跟着倒。

quiz.q: Not only ___ sing, but he also dances.

topics.title: 虚拟语气 (wish)
topics.summary: wish后从句用过去时(现在)/过去完成时(过去)/would(将来)表愿望
topics.detail: wish引导宾语从句表'希望…就好了'，谓语形式：①与现在事实相反用一般过去时(be用were)：I wish I were rich.(希望我现在有钱) ②与过去事实相反用过去完成时：I wish I had studied harder.(希望我当时更努力) ③与将来事实相反用would/could/might+动词原形：I wish you would stop talking.(希望你别说了) ④wish与hope区别：hope表可能实现的希望(用将来时)，wish表难以实现的愿望(用虚拟)。⑤If only用法同wish但更具感情色彩：If only I were younger! ⑥would rather后也用虚拟：I would rather you didn't smoke. ⑦wish后从句不用should。⑧wish的语气比hope更强烈且多带遗憾。⑨were用于所有人称(正式)，口语中was也常见。⑩as if/as though后表虚拟时同wish用法。

examples.en: I wish I were a bird.
examples.cn: 我希望我是一只鸟。(与现在相反)

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
examples.cn: 我希望我当时更努力学习。(与过去相反)

examples.en: I wish you would stop smoking.
examples.cn: 我希望你能戒烟。(与将来相反)

examples.en: If only I were younger!

topics.tips: 口诀：wish现在用过去，wish过去用过去完；wish将来用would，were用于各人称。

quiz.q: I wish I ___ harder last year.

topics.title: 虚拟条件句
topics.summary: 与现在/过去/将来事实相反的if从句谓语形式
topics.detail: 虚拟条件句分三种情况：①与现在事实相反：if从句用过去时(be用were)，主句用would/could/should/might+动词原形。If I were you, I would go.(如果我是你，我会去) ②与过去事实相反：if从句用过去完成时(had done)，主句用would/could/should/might+have done。If I had known, I would have helped.(如果我早知道，我就帮忙了) ③与将来事实相反：if从句用were to do或should do，主句用would/could+动词原形。If it were to rain tomorrow, I would stay home. ④if可省略，把had/were/should提到主语前倒装：Had I known, I would have helped. ⑤错综时间条件句根据实际时间调整。⑥as if/as though表虚拟时同条件句。⑦would rather+从句用虚拟。⑧suggest/demand/insist等后的从句用should+动词原形(should可省)。

examples.en: If I were you, I would go.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我会去。(与现在相反)

examples.en: If I had known, I would have helped.
examples.cn: 如果我知道，我就帮忙了。(与过去相反)

examples.en: If it should rain, I would stay home.
examples.cn: 万一明天下雨，我就待在家。(与将来相反)

examples.en: Had I known, I would have helped.
examples.cn: 早知道我就帮忙了。(if省略倒装)

topics.tips: 口诀：现在过去be用were，过去完成had done；将来should或were to，主句would加动词原。

quiz.q: If I ___ you, I would go.
If I ___ known, I would have helped.
___ I known, I would have helped.
